description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**


We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team.


This is a hands\-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. This is not a primarily administrative or people management position.


The ideal candidate is a software engineer with deep Microsoft Power Platform expertise who can combine low code capabilities with custom development, enterprise architecture, and strong consulting skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a hands\-on engineer and technical lead for complex client engagements involving Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design and build enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and related Microsoft technologies.
* Develop custom solutions using C\#/.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, and other extensibility approaches.
* Design scalable Dataverse architectures, including data models, security, integrations, business logic, and performance considerations.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, APIs, and other enterprise systems.
* Implement strong ALM practices including source control, solution management, deployment automation, environment strategy, and CI/CD.
* Lead technical discovery sessions and translate business requirements into practical, well\-designed solutions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership across multiple engagements and act as an escalation point for complex engineering challenges.
* Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, code quality expectations, and delivery best practices.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team.
* Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience.
* 4 or more years of substantial hands\-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience.
* Strong software development experience using C\#/.NET and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems.
* Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects.
* Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.
* Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices.
* Experience with Azure technologies such as Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
* Experience working in consulting or professional services environments.
* Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials.

**What Success Looks Like**


Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges.


They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.

 **What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Computer Scientist II (Full Stack)
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Firefly Enterprise brings generative AI and automated document production into the infrastructure that powers enterprise creative operations at scale. Our team builds and operates the
 **InDesign APIs and InDesign Server platform on Firefly Services** 
 —the systems that let enterprises programmatically generate, resize, localize, and republish complex, pixel\-perfect layouts (catalogs, packaging, marketing collateral) across thousands of variants, with no manual production work.
   

  

 We're at an inflection point. The InDesign APIs are scaling fast in production, and we are migrating a large base of InDesign Server customers and partners onto the API platform. That means we need engineers who can ship durable, well\-documented APIs
 *and* 
 a horizontally scalable, observable server platform that holds up under heavy, bursty enterprise load.
   

  

**The problem we're solving:** 
 large enterprises need to produce and localize high\-fidelity layouts at a volume and speed that manual design workflows can't sustain. Today that often means brittle scripts, single\-purpose render farms, and integrations that don't survive enterprise load. We're building reliable, well\-documented APIs and a scalable server platform that make InDesign automation dependable, observable, and easy to build on.
   

  

 This is a full\-stack role: you'll build customer\- and developer\-facing surfaces (job consoles, dashboards, monitors) while working inside the services and server infrastructure that do the heavy lifting—job orchestration, template processing, rendering pipelines, and the APIs that expose it all.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Build full\-stack features spanning UI (React/TypeScript or similar) and backend services (Node.js/Java) that expose InDesign API and InDesign Server capabilities to enterprise customers and internal teams.
* Develop and maintain REST/GraphQL APIs for document generation, template/asset management, job submission, and status/result retrieval—including auth, entitlements and usage metering, rate limiting, and versioning.
* Work with InDesign Server internals, scripting (UXP/ExtendScript), and plugin interfaces to build and troubleshoot automated rendering, pagination, and content\-mapping workflows.
* Build reliable async job orchestration: queuing, polling, retries, partial\-failure handling, and clear progress/status UX for long\-running render jobs.
* Contribute to platform reliability—multi\-region operation, stability, performance, and observability—for high\-volume document generation.
* Own features end\-to\-end: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring across the stack.
* Partner with Product, Design, and Platform to turn enterprise requirements (scale, compliance, entitlements) into robust solutions, and directly support IDS→API migration by closing feature and performance gaps.
* Champion engineering quality: unit/integration testing, code reviews, CI/CD hygiene, pragmatic tech\-debt management. Mentor junior engineers through reviews, pairing, and design discussions.


 What you need to succeed
   

  

* 6–8 years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrated full\-stack, end\-to\-end ownership.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one backend language/runtime (Node.js, Java, or similar), with solid component\-based UI development and HTML/CSS.
* Proven experience building and integrating REST/GraphQL APIs and designing systems around asynchronous, long\-running workflows.
* Comfort across the stack: from UI implementation to service design, data models, and deployment/infrastructure basics.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Voice AI)
description:
You'll be the person who builds the machinery behind our AI calling agents. At JoyzAI, that means the real\-time voice pipeline itself — audio in, speech understood, LLM reasoning, tools called, speech out — and everything around it: the telephony that gets the call connected, the dashboard a client uses to configure their agent, and the webhooks and CRM plumbing that turn a call into a lead.
 



 This is not a feature\-ticket role. It's a build\-and\-own role. You'll own the voice stack end to end, from the socket that streams audio to the screen a client uses to change their agent's greeting. When a call stutters, drops, or talks over the customer, you're the one who finds out why — and fixes it.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  





 Voice pipeline \& real\-time systems
 


* Build and harden the real\-time calling pipeline: telephony ↔ audio streaming ↔ speech/real\-time models ↔ tool calls ↔ speech out, with latency you can't feel.
* Own the hard voice problems: turn\-taking and barge\-in, silence and voicemail detection, noise and echo, language switching mid\-call (English ↔ Hinglish ↔ regional), and graceful recovery when a model or carrier hiccups.
* Integrate and evaluate voice models and providers across STT/TTS, real\-time LLMs, VAD, and telephony carriers — and help decide what we build on next.
* Implement non\-blocking tool calling inside live calls — lookups, bookings, CRM writes — so the agent never goes silent or loses the thread.



  





 Platform \& full\-stack product
 


* Build the product around the calls: agent configuration (tasks, behaviour, guardrails, AI config), call logs and transcripts, analytics, and bulk\-calling campaign controls.
* Design and ship the Node.js/Express services and APIs — call orchestration, queueing, webhooks, retries, recording and transcript storage — that hold up as call volume grows.
* Wire calls into the rest of the platform: CRM contacts and tickets, WhatsApp follow\-ups after a call, calendar and booking integrations, Google Sheets and Meta lead\-form ingestion.
* Ship clean, usable Angular frontends for our team and for clients — the agent configurator, the inbox, the call review screens.



  





 Reliability, cost \& scale
 


* Instrument everything: time\-to\-first\-word, per\-call latency breakdowns, drop rates, tool\-call failures, model cost per minute. Build the dashboards that tell us something's wrong before a client does.
* Bring down cost per minute without hurting quality — model choice, streaming strategy, caching, carrier routing.
* Debug production incidents on real client calls, reproduce them, and fix them at the root.



  





 Working with the team
 


* Pair with the prompt engineer and customer success on what the platform needs for agents to behave well — new tool types, better fallbacks, a proper test harness for prompts.
* Turn what you learn from client deployments into reusable platform capability, so the next voice agent takes hours to stand up, not days.



  





 Roughly 80% of your time is hands\-on engineering: writing code across the stack, debugging live calls, shipping. The other 20% is with the team and occasionally clients — understanding what's breaking in the field and deciding what the platform should do about it.
 



  





 We're under 15 people building AI calling agents. This is not a comfortable corporate job. You'll be in the trenches, you'll work hard, and you'll compress ten years of ordinary career growth into two (this means salary growth also, not just more work).
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




  





 Two things are non\-negotiable. Please apply only if you meet both — they're the first thing we screen for.
 


* **You've shipped real\-time voice AI to production.** 
 Not a demo, not a hackathon — a system where real people spoke to an AI over a phone line or live audio stream, and you owned the pipeline: streaming audio, speech or real\-time models, latency, interruptions, the lot. Experience at a Voice AI company is a strong signal.
* **You're a full\-stack engineer who can build the whole thing.** 
 Backend services, APIs, real\-time transport, databases, and a frontend a client can use without a walkthrough. You don't need a separate team to ship a feature end to end.



  





 Beyond that, we don't care much about degrees or years. We care that you can:
 


* Work fluently across the MEAN stack — MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node.js — with TypeScript throughout.
* Build and debug real\-time systems: WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming audio, event\-driven architectures, queues.
* Integrate with telephony/SIP providers and messaging APIs (WhatsApp Business API) and handle their quirks in production.
* Work with LLM APIs, tool/function calling, and speech models, and reason about latency, cost, and failure modes — not just accuracy.
* Design MongoDB data models and APIs for a multi\-tenant SaaS: contacts, conversations, tickets, workflows, role\-based access.
* Measure and profile before you optimise, write code others can read, and document what you built.



  





 Nice to have: experience with real\-time voice frameworks or APIs (OpenAI Realtime, LiveKit, Pipecat, or similar); Indian telephony providers; Hinglish or Indic speech models; GCP/AWS at scale.
 



  





 Full\-time, on\-site in Noida.
 



  





**Why JoyzAI?** 




 ✨ Utmost freedom and autonomy — to make decisions. You are the taskmaster, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.
 



 ✨ Complete responsibility. You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.
 



 ✨ Top\-of\-the\-market pay – we reward high performance with the best packages.
 



 ✨ 5\-day working – weekends are yours to recharge.
 



 ✨ Work from office in Noida – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.
 



 ✨ High\-growth startup – opportunity to see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that.

**Architecture → Product → Frontend → Backend → Mobile → Infrastructure → Deployment → Scale** 




 You will be responsible for transforming the vision into the actual technology that powers Sovereign Detailing Co.
 



 You won't be handed a massive engineering team and a finished roadmap.
 



**You will help build both.** 




  




 THE MINDSET
 
  





 We are not looking for someone who wants a comfortable corporate CTO title.
 



 We are looking for a
 **builder** 
 .
 



 Someone who can sit down on Day One with the founder, understand the vision, challenge assumptions, design the architecture and start building.
 



 Someone who sees a blank repository as an opportunity.
 



 Someone who wants their work to become
 **the technology foundation of a company that didn't exist before they helped build it.** 




  




 WHY THIS OPPORTUNITY IS DIFFERENT
 
  





 The biggest technology companies in the world were once just ideas.
 



 The difference was that someone decided to build them.
 



  





**This is that stage.** 




  





 You won't be joining after the product is built.
 



 You won't be joining after the technology team is established.
 



  





**You'll be there at the beginning.** 




  





 You'll have a direct influence on what we build, how we build it, and how far it can scale.
 



 If we build this the way we believe we can, you'll be able to look back years from now and say:
 



**“I built the technology from the ground up.”** 




  




 THE STANDARD
 
  





 We expect the level of thinking and execution you would associate with
 **Meta, Amazon, Flipkart, SpaceX or another world\-class technology organization.** 




 Not because we're trying to imitate them.
 



**Because that's the standard we're setting for ourselves.** 




  





 If you're genuinely exceptional, technically strong, relentlessly ambitious and ready to build something from zero:
 



  





**We want to hear from you.** 




  





**Role:** 
 Co\-Founder \& CTO
 



**Location:** 
 Remote / Flexible
 



**Stage:** 
 Pre\-Seed
 



**Structure:** 
 Founding partnership — equity \+ mutually agreed terms
 



  





**Apply:** 
 Send a DM with your profile, GitHub/portfolio, what you've built, your technical background, and why you believe you are the person who should build the technology behind Sovereign Detailing Co.
 



  





**One seat. One founding team. One opportunity to build something from the beginning.**

title: Fullstack Developer Lead
description:
**About Our Company**
 Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.
   

  

 Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Description Summary
   

  

 This role for an experienced full\-stack engineer to provide people engineering SME and support to our business partners in the Asset Management. The candidate should be hands on in advanced programing, visualization, analytical models and algorithms. The candidate should demonstrate strong technical/problem solving skills, manage multiple projects collaboratively and ensure adherence to enterprise standards. You’ll work with smart, talented people across our business to create innovative, next\-generation cloud\-based applications, and analytics/models. You’ll be involved, hands\-on, through the entire development cycle. And you’ll redefine the way our traders, portfolio managers and analysts support our clients.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Design and build the next generation of the world's best investment management technology platform, focusing on managing various investment lifecycle processes and investment research.
   

  

* Lead and mentor a team of software developers, providing guidance and support throughout the software development lifecycle. Solve complex problems; research and bring in new and advanced machine learning concepts; takes a new perspective using existing solutions. Provides input on tool and technology selection, standards and shares evolving best practices. Participates in discovery sessions to identify opportunities to leverage analytics to automate and enhance business processes. Operate independently in a product centric culture with sense of ownership and accountability. Refine business and functional requirements and translate them into scalable technical designs. Collaborate with product engineering teams to implement comprehensive AI/ML\-based solutions from start to finish.
* Apply quality software engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Optimize the software delivery and workflow of the team.
* Work with team members in a multi\-office, multi\-country environment.


**Required Qualifications**
 B.S./M.S. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related subject area with 7\+ years, or equivalent experience
   

  

 Strong hands\-on experience with:Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django)
   

  

 React.js
   

  

 SQL (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
   

  

 AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway)
   

  

 Experience with REST APIs, Git, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies.
   

  

 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
   

  

 Should have excellent communication skills, should be able to interact with business system analysts and get clear understanding of requirements.
   

  

 In\-Office Collaboration
   

  

 We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders.
